vb_textbox.text: I selected either the gnome with the pointy hat or the round hat. If the one I chose gave me a good amount of mushrooms (3+), I would choose the same one on the next turn. I would keep choosing the gnome with the same hat for a while as it tended to keep providing a lot of mushrooms. If the number of mushrooms decreased, or especially if it went to 0, I would choose the other gnome, and if this seemed better would continue with that one for a while. Sometimes it wasn't clear which gnome was best, so I would maybe try twice, and then alternate until a pattern started to emerge again.
